requirements.summary: Robot executes the exact candidate whose digest and version identity are recorded in the build receipt.
The candidate exposes truthful help for its public automation surface.
The candidate generates non-empty bash, zsh, and fish completions.
Automation failures use stable machine-readable JSON.
Multiple independent source roots can be initialized without sharing manifests.
Initialization does not fabricate stored sessions and status reports the absent-session state.
A recovery request without a session fails with an exact safe next command.
Every Robot test maps to a known active requirement and every required-now requirement has an executing test.
The exact candidate opens a real DevPod and Hauler-backed Camp and returns a durable session identity.
The exact candidate attaches to the selected live session and requested landing target through DevPod.
requirements.gate: candidate black-box attach scenario with a real open session

requirements.summary: The exact candidate publishes a verified checkpoint while leaving the selected workspace open.
The exact candidate publishes before identity-checked teardown and reports publication separately from cleanup.
A fresh XDG controller reopens the latest committed generation without reusing prior controller state.
requirements.gate: TestLocalLifecycleVertical and TestMinIOLifecycleVertical with fresh-controller evidence

requirements.summary: Two initialized Camps and concurrent sessions route open, attach, sync, close, status, and reopen without cross-selection.
Checkpoint and reopen preserve bytes, modes, Unicode, spaces, relative symlinks, hardlinks, deletes, and files larger than 2 MiB.
An image explicitly pushed through CAMP_REGISTRY is sealed by digest, evicted, reopened, digest-pulled, and run.
requirements.gate: TestLocalLifecycleVertical and TestMinIOLifecycleVertical explicit registry digest proof

requirements.summary: The exact candidate publishes to MinIO and reopens through a fresh credential-chain controller.
Two writers cannot both advance the same pointer baseline and a loser never overwrites the winner.
A verified upload that loses pointer compare-and-swap remains an inspectable recoverable orphan generation.
requirements.gate: MinIO immutable publication plus exact-candidate recover receipt

requirements.summary: Crash cuts across lifecycle effects reconcile known outcomes without replaying completed effects or guessing unknown ones.
Supervisor claim, heartbeat, replacement, and shutdown use exact durable process identity and lease state.
requirements.gate: focused supervisor recovery tests plus an exact-candidate crash cut

requirements.summary: A surviving detached forwarder is adopted from private identity evidence and stopped exactly once.
Expired, replaced, and stale writer leases fail closed or renew only through exact conditional identity.
requirements.gate: lease recovery tests plus exact-candidate recover or strike scenario

requirements.summary: Cleanup removes only ledgered workspace IDs, recorded processes, closed ports, and ownership-verified materializations.
Cleanup preserves a real unrelated DevPod workspace in the same authorized provider.
Every real scenario owns DEVPOD_HOME, DEVPOD_CONFIG, SSH config, and a non-default context.
Registry and fileserver listeners are loopback-confined, identity-observed, forwarded, and closed by their owner.
requirements.gate: TestLocalLifecycleVertical and TestMinIOLifecycleVertical listener and teardown evidence

requirements.summary: Successful lifecycle commands return deterministic redacted JSON read models from the exact candidate.
requirements.gate: candidate black-box JSON success assertions for open, sync, close, and reopen

requirements.summary: Human progress reports only completed durable stages while JSON remains one non-streamed success envelope.
requirements.gate: candidate black-box human milestone and JSON envelope parity scenario

requirements.summary: Failure receipts distinguish safe publication, cleanup failure, orphan generation, and the exact recovery command.
The locked Room matrix exercises published variants, with Wolfi nested networking, Docker build, registry push, reopen, run, and Rust continuity.
requirements.gate: authorized Room matrix using the fixture version in tools.lock.yaml

requirements.summary: Kubernetes support is claimed only from the protected authorized exact-candidate lifecycle gate.
Generated docs, transcripts, root and subcommand help, and bash, zsh, and fish completions match the exact candidate.
requirements.gate: go test ./internal/docsgen ./docs plus packaged candidate completion verification

requirements.summary: Every product-proof lane consumes one executable whose digest remains equal to the immutable candidate receipt.
requirements.gate: RCC robot gate candidate digest checks before and after all named evidence

requirements.summary: Automatically enumerate and capture every named workspace-engine image.
Treat the live registry catalog as the complete direct-push publication inventory.
